messages:
Hana (Orbit): hi all — onboarding stalled: after scaling our service during QA, we saw a cascade of 429s from /v1/auth. first few auths are 200 then many 429s. using python-sdk 1.9. region: eu-west-2. anyone seen this pattern?

Priya (CS): thanks for reporting. do you call auth during readiness/liveness? any parallel startups?

Hana (Orbit): yes we do. our deploy spikes from 3 -> 50 pods, each does `client.login()` on startup. health checks hit /ready which can trigger login if token not present. logs: 200,200,200,429,429,429 repeated.

Noah (SDK Eng): sounds like a token refresh stampede. immediate client fixes: stop calling auth from probes; centralize token fetch (file-backed cache or a tiny sidecar) so simultaneous inits reuse tokens; add exponential backoff with jitter (start 250ms cap 5s). also avoid super-tight retry loops.

Priya (CS): we can request a short-lived uplift for your key in eu-west-2 while you patch. what time window do you need?

Hana (Orbit): need ~30min to deploy hotfix. can we get a 1-hour uplift?

ops-bot: Support ticket #23166 created for account "Orbit" — action: temporary per-key rate uplift (1 hour) region: eu-west-2.

Noah (SDK Eng): also add a small randomized startup delay (0-1200ms) per replica and, if possible, gate concurrent auth with a local mutex so only N inits run at once. we'll add an example to the docs showing a safe init pattern for containerized apps.

Hana (Orbit): implementing backoff+jitter + startup delay, disabling auth in readiness. redeploying now. will attach auth success/failure counts to ticket.

Priya (CS): leaving ticket open for 1 hour; will cancel early if telemetry looks green. thanks for the fast turnaround.

Hana (Orbit): redeploy complete, no 429s in the last 3 mins. huge thanks!
